title: Crop, split, and shift captions across a ripple or insert interval
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: Ripple delete, range close, ripple trim shorten/lengthen, and insert paste or insert-move crop, split, and shift absolute cues across that interval and rebind clipLocal remnants to a covering host.

Insert-move still leaves a source gap and does not auto-close it; captions are applied after moved hosts are placed again so clipLocal cues on an unsplit moving host are not split at the destination hole.
A cue wholly inside a closed interval is dropped as crop-to-empty and returns on undo; remnants without a covering host refuse the whole command (ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE).

Source anchors stay CAPTION_RICH_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; a locked caption track is FIELD_LOCKED for the whole group; listing a caption track as a media ripple track stays CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
MP4 text burn-in stays CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; sidecar VTT is the export path.
Not auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, marker business, I-006, default-on-create clipLocal, or 1000 random NLE undo.
I-005 remains partial; I-010 remainingAcceptance unchanged; 87 counts stay 26/48/13/0; XD10 unchanged.
Previous 119/104/95/85/75/64/51/37/7/281 counts are not mixed in.
